verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's Conditional Access page documents device-compliance-based access control: access is revoked when a device falls out of compliance or is off a trusted network. JumpCloud Go also ties passwordless web access to managed devices. The evidence does not show which posture attributes a policy can evaluate, nor that the check gates the SSO app session at sign-in. Missing for 10: documented posture conditions (managed, disk encryption, screen lock) in the auth policy, explicit pre-session enforcement for SSO apps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, only healthy devices get in — device posture (managed, encrypted, screen-locked) is checked in the auth policy before an app session is granted

citations.quote: when users aren’t on a trusted network and/or if a device falls out of compliance, access is revoked instantly—no manual intervention required
